title: What Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0 Is
definition: Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0: next-gen reusable winged orbiters.
description:
Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0: next-gen reusable winged orbiters. This is Future Transport & Mobility at its most ambitious — TPS tiles research, shuttle logistics engineering and turnaround ops operations converging on a single goal: making shuttle hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Transport & Mobility will decide runway landings outcomes this century. Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0 is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working shuttle hulls, the larger TPS tiles vision stalls, and with it, the shuttle logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0 in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0.
description:
The road to Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0 is already being paved. Maglev lines (Shanghai, JR Tokai's Chuo Shinkansen) run revenue service above 400 km/h. Autonomous shipping trials (Yara Birkeland, MAS) test crewless cargo vessels.

Hyperloop test tracks (Virgin Hyperloop heritage, European pilots) probe vacuum-tube transport. Together these programs form the TPS tiles foundation that Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0 will build on — the shuttle logistics results, the turnaround ops methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as shuttle logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where TPS tiles monitoring, shuttle logistics redundancy, or turnaround ops maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Spaceplane Shuttles 2.0 — next-gen reusable winged orbiters.

Phase 1 — Prove (TPS tiles): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (shuttle logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (turnaround ops): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (runway landings): shuttle hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and orbit-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
